items.headline: China's economic growth slows significantly in May with retail sales experiencing a rare decline.
items.teaser: China's economy showed further signs of weakening in May, with retail sales experiencing their first decline in over three years, while u…
items.story:
China's economy showed further signs of weakening in May, with retail sales experiencing their first decline in over three years, while urban investment contracted more sharply than anticipated. This downturn marks a significant shift in the country's economic trajectory, which had previously been driven by consumer spending. The decline in retail sales is particularly notable, as it indicates a decrease in domestic demand. According to official data, the drop in retail sales is the first since May 2020, highlighting the challenges facing the Chinese economy.

The slowdown in China's economy is not an isolated event, but rather part of a broader trend that has been unfolding over the past year. The country's economic growth has been impacted by a combination of factors, including a decline in exports, a slowdown in the property market, and a resurgence of COVID-19 cases. Additionally, the government's zero-COVID policy has led to widespread lockdowns, further constraining economic activity. As a result, China's economy has been facing significant headwinds, with the latest data on retail sales and urban investment adding to concerns about the outlook for growth.

The data released by the National Bureau of Statistics showed that retail sales fell by 0.7% in May compared to the same period last year, while urban investment contracted by 0.6% over the first five months of the year. These figures are weaker than expected, and they suggest that the Chinese economy is facing significant challenges. The decline in urban investment is particularly concerning, as it indicates a decrease in spending on infrastructure and other projects. Officials have attributed the slowdown to a range of factors, including the impact of COVID-19 and a decline in business confidence.

The reaction to the latest economic data has been muted, with many analysts and investors already anticipating a slowdown in China's economy. However, the scale of the decline in retail sales and urban investment has caught some observers off guard, and there are concerns that the downturn could be more pronounced than expected. The Chinese government has responded by pledging to take steps to support the economy, including increasing spending on infrastructure and providing support to small businesses. The impact of these measures remains to be seen, but they are likely to be closely watched by investors and analysts.

The slowdown in China's economy has significant implications for the global economy, as the country is a major driver of growth and a key trading partner for many nations. The decline in Chinese demand is likely to have a ripple effect on other economies, particularly those that are heavily reliant on exports to China. Additionally, the slowdown in China's economy could also have an impact on global commodity prices, as the country is a major consumer of raw materials. As a result, the latest economic data from China is being closely watched by policymakers and investors around the world.

As the Chinese government seeks to respond to the economic slowdown, there are likely to be a number of key decisions made in the coming weeks and months. One of the main questions is whether the government will be able to implement effective measures to support the economy, and whether these measures will be sufficient to reverse the downturn. Additionally, there are concerns about the potential impact of the slowdown on China's debt levels, as well as the potential for further declines in the value of the yuan. As a result, the situation in China will be closely watched by investors and analysts, who will be looking for signs of a recovery or further deterioration in the economy.

The incident occurred during a routine test mission, with the bomber going down near the base. The US Air Force has confirmed that the crash is being investigated, but few details have been released so far.

The B-52 Stratofortress is a long-range, multi-role bomber that has been in service with the US Air Force since the 1950s. With a history spanning over six decades, the aircraft has played a significant role in various military operations and has undergone numerous upgrades to maintain its capabilities. The Edwards Air Force Base, where the crash occurred, is a major testing and training facility for the US Air Force, and the B-52 is one of the many aircraft that regularly operate from the base. The crash is a significant incident, given the importance of the B-52 in the US military's arsenal.

The investigation will likely involve a thorough examination of the aircraft's maintenance records, as well as interviews with witnesses and surviving crew members. This development is seen as a possible goodwill gesture ahead of the in-person signing ceremony scheduled for Friday in Geneva. The Strait of Hormuz is a strategic waterway that connects the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman and is a critical route for international oil shipments. The reopening of the strait has been anticipated as a key outcome of the US-Iran deal, which aims to ease tensions and improve relations between the two countries.

The US and Iran have had a complex and often contentious relationship, with periods of heightened tension and conflict, particularly in recent years. The signing of the memorandum of understanding marks a significant step towards improving relations and reducing tensions in the region.

The reopening of the Strait of Hormuz has significant implications for the region and the global economy. The deal between the US and Iran is also seen as a positive development for regional stability, as it reduces tensions and improves relations between the two countries. However, many challenges remain, including the need to address ongoing security concerns and to ensure the safe passage of ships through the strait. The international community will be watching the situation closely, as the implementation of the deal has the potential to have far-reaching consequences for the region and the global economy.

As the situation continues to unfold, many questions remain unanswered, including the timing and scope of the strait's full reopening and the impact on global oil markets. Meta is introducing a new AI Mode search feature on Facebook, which will utilize information from public posts to generate results, a development that marks a significant shift in how the platform approaches search functionality. This new feature will appear alongside existing search modes, such as People and Marketplace, allowing users to opt for AI-generated results. The rollout of AI Mode is part of a broader effort by Meta to integrate artificial intelligence into its services. The feature is set to become available to users starting today, as part of a suite of new AI-powered tools.

The introduction of AI Mode search on Facebook reflects the company's ongoing efforts to enhance user experience through the use of artificial intelligence. Meta has been investing heavily in AI research and development, aiming to leverage machine learning algorithms to improve various aspects of its platforms. The decision to draw on public posts for AI Mode search results underscores the importance of user-generated content in shaping the platform's functionality. By tapping into this vast repository of information, Meta seeks to provide more personalized and relevant search results for its users.

According to Meta, the AI Mode search feature will be capable of generating results based on patterns and trends identified in public posts. This will enable users to discover new content and connections that they may not have found through traditional search methods. Additionally, Meta is introducing photo presets that can swap sports jerseys onto users' photos, further showcasing the company's push into AI-driven features. These developments demonstrate Meta's commitment to exploring innovative applications of artificial intelligence across its platforms.

The rollout of AI Mode search and other AI-powered features is likely to have significant implications for Facebook users, who will need to adapt to a new search paradigm. As with any major platform update, the response from stakeholders and the broader public will be closely watched, with potential impacts on user engagement and the platform's overall ecosystem.

The introduction of AI Mode search on Facebook is part of a larger trend towards increased adoption of artificial intelligence in social media and online services. As companies like Meta continue to invest in AI research and development, users can expect to see more innovative applications of machine learning and natural language processing. The global implications of this shift will be significant, with potential effects on data privacy, online discourse, and the future of digital communication. As AI-driven features become more prevalent, regulators and users alike will need to navigate the complex issues surrounding their use.

As Meta continues to roll out its new AI-powered features, the company will likely face questions about data privacy, user consent, and the potential risks associated with relying on public posts to inform search results. The success of AI Mode search will depend on the company's ability to address these concerns while providing a compelling and useful experience for its users. In the coming months, Meta's approach to AI integration will be closely watched, with potential decisions on data governance, transparency, and user control likely to have far-reaching consequences for the platform and its users.

The UK government has announced plans to ban children under the age of 16 from using social media, with the proposed ban set to come into effect by spring 2027 if passed by parliament. As the proposal makes its way through parliament, it is likely that there will be further debate and discussion over the merits and potential consequences of the ban.

items.headline: Medical Experts Recommend Simple Lifestyle Changes to Combat Age-Related Muscle Atrophy
items.teaser: As people age, they inevitably experience a loss of muscle mass, a condition known as sarcopenia, which can lead to frailty and increased…
items.story:
As people age, they inevitably experience a loss of muscle mass, a condition known as sarcopenia, which can lead to frailty and increased risk of falls. Doctors and health experts have long emphasized the importance of maintaining muscle strength and mass as we grow older. According to recent reports, certain exercises and lifestyle changes can help mitigate age-related muscle loss. Researchers and medical professionals agree that a combination of strength training, proper nutrition, and regular physical activity can significantly slow down muscle loss. This is particularly crucial for individuals over the age of 60, as they are more susceptible to the adverse effects of sarcopenia.

The loss of muscle mass is a natural part of the aging process, but it can be accelerated by a sedentary lifestyle and poor dietary habits. Historically, muscle loss was seen as an inevitable consequence of aging, but recent studies have shown that it is possible to prevent or slow down this process through targeted interventions. Experts point out that maintaining strong muscles is essential for overall health and well-being, as it supports cognitive function, mobility, and longevity. Furthermore, research has highlighted the importance of leg strength, in particular, as strong legs are critical for balance, stability, and overall physical function.

Specifically, doctors recommend that individuals engage in strength training exercises, such as squats, lunges, and leg presses, to build and maintain muscle mass. Additionally, a balanced diet that includes adequate protein, vitamins, and minerals is essential for supporting muscle health. Experts also emphasize the importance of incorporating physical activity into daily routines, such as walking, cycling, or swimming, to help maintain muscle function and mobility. According to some reports, even simple exercises, such as chair squats and leg raises, can be effective in restoring muscle tone and strength, particularly in older adults.

The response to these recommendations has been positive, with many individuals taking proactive steps to maintain their muscle strength and overall health. Stakeholders, including healthcare providers and fitness professionals, are also responding by developing and promoting exercise programs and nutritional guidance tailored to the needs of older adults. Moreover, there is a growing recognition of the importance of preventing muscle loss, not just for individual health and well-being but also for reducing the economic and social burden of age-related disabilities.

In the broader context, the emphasis on preventing muscle loss is part of a larger effort to promote healthy aging and reduce the risk of age-related diseases. This includes initiatives to encourage physical activity, healthy eating, and social engagement, as well as research into the underlying causes of sarcopenia and other age-related conditions. Globally, there is a growing recognition of the need to address the challenges of aging populations, and efforts to promote healthy aging are being undertaken by governments, healthcare systems, and community organizations.

As researchers and healthcare professionals continue to explore the causes and consequences of muscle loss, there are likely to be new developments and recommendations in the field. In the meantime, individuals can take proactive steps to maintain their muscle strength and overall health by incorporating strength training, physical activity, and healthy eating into their daily routines. Additionally, healthcare providers and policymakers will need to work together to develop and implement effective strategies for promoting healthy aging and reducing the burden of age-related diseases, including those related to muscle loss.

items.story:
Researchers have identified several afternoon habits that can have a negative impact on heart health, affecting millions of people worldwide who may not even be aware of the risks. According to recent studies, everyday activities and behaviors that occur in the afternoon can quietly work against heart health, increasing the risk of cardiovascular disease. The American Heart Association has long emphasized the importance of maintaining a healthy lifestyle to prevent heart disease, and understanding these habits is crucial to mitigating this risk. By being aware of these habits, individuals can take steps to modify their behavior and reduce their risk of heart disease.

The importance of maintaining heart health cannot be overstated, as cardiovascular disease remains one of the leading causes of death globally. A significant body of research has focused on the role of diet and exercise in preventing heart disease, but less attention has been paid to the impact of daily habits and behaviors. However, experts now recognize that habits such as sitting for long periods, consuming high-sugar snacks, and experiencing stress can all contribute to an increased risk of heart disease. As people go about their daily lives, they may not realize the cumulative effect of these habits on their heart health. Understanding the specific ways in which afternoon habits can affect heart health is essential to developing effective prevention strategies.

Studies have shown that afternoon habits such as taking a long nap, watching excessive television, and eating unhealthy snacks can all have a negative impact on heart health. For example, research has found that taking a nap of more than 30 minutes can increase the risk of cardiovascular disease, while consuming high-sugar snacks can lead to inflammation and damage to blood vessels. Additionally, experts recommend that individuals aim to limit their sedentary behavior, such as sitting for long periods, and instead engage in physical activity to reduce their risk of heart disease. By being mindful of these habits and making small changes, individuals can significantly reduce their risk of heart disease.

The identification of these afternoon habits has significant implications for public health, as it highlights the importance of maintaining a healthy lifestyle throughout the day. Health experts are now emphasizing the need for individuals to be aware of their daily habits and to make conscious choices to prioritize their heart health. This may involve taking regular breaks to engage in physical activity, choosing healthy snacks, and managing stress through techniques such as meditation or deep breathing. By taking these steps, individuals can reduce their risk of heart disease and maintain overall health and well-being.

The impact of these afternoon habits extends beyond individual health, as it also has implications for the broader healthcare system. As the prevalence of heart disease continues to rise, healthcare systems are facing increasing pressure to provide effective prevention and treatment strategies. By promoting awareness of the importance of maintaining heart health and providing resources to support healthy habits, healthcare systems can play a critical role in reducing the burden of heart disease. Furthermore, employers and policymakers can also take steps to support heart health, such as providing access to physical activity programs and promoting healthy work environments.

As research continues to uncover the complex relationships between daily habits and heart health, it is likely that new strategies for prevention and treatment will emerge. In the meantime, individuals can take proactive steps to prioritize their heart health by being mindful of their afternoon habits and making conscious choices to reduce their risk of heart disease. By working together to promote heart health, individuals, healthcare systems, and policymakers can help to reduce the burden of cardiovascular disease and improve overall health and well-being.

The announcement was made just hours after an Israeli military operation in southern Lebanon, where Israeli forces still occupy dozens of villages. The development has significant implications for the region, particularly for Lebanon, where the agreement could potentially bring relief to civilians affected by the conflict. According to Iranian officials, the deal represents a major breakthrough in relations between the two countries.

The US-Iran relationship has been strained for decades, with tensions escalating in recent years over issues such as nuclear proliferation and regional influence. The conflict in Lebanon has been a major point of contention, with Israel occupying southern Lebanon and Hezbollah, an Iranian-backed militant group, operating in the region. The announcement of a ceasefire in Lebanon is a significant development, as it could potentially bring an end to the violence and instability that has plagued the region for years. The deal is also seen as a major diplomatic achievement for the Trump administration, which has been seeking to negotiate a peace agreement with Iran.

According to Lorenzo Trombetta, a senior analyst for ANSA, the deal represents a strategic gain for Iran, which has been seeking to expand its influence in the region. Trombetta noted that from an Iranian perspective, the deal provides a concrete strategic advantage, particularly in terms of its relationship with Lebanon. The deal is also seen as a major concession by the US, which has been seeking to isolate Iran and limit its influence in the region. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has been accused of trying to undermine the agreement on the ground, highlighting the challenges that lie ahead in implementing the deal.

The announcement of the deal has been met with relief in Lebanon, where civilians have been affected by the conflict for years. However, tensions have risen in Israel, where the deal is seen as a major concession to Iran and a threat to Israeli security. The Israeli government has yet to comment on the deal, but it is likely to face significant opposition from Israeli lawmakers and citizens. The deal is also likely to have significant implications for the wider region, particularly in terms of the balance of power between Iran and its rivals, such as Saudi Arabia and Israel.

The deal is part of a broader effort by the Trump administration to negotiate peace agreements in the Middle East, including a recent deal between Israel and the United Arab Emirates. However, the deal with Iran is seen as a major challenge, given the significant differences between the two countries and the ongoing tensions in the region. The implementation of the deal will require significant cooperation between the US, Iran, and other regional players, including Israel and Lebanon. The deal is also likely to face significant scrutiny from lawmakers and citizens in the US, who will be seeking to understand the terms of the agreement and its implications for US foreign policy.

As the details of the deal become clearer, it is likely that there will be significant debate and discussion about its implications and potential consequences. The US Congress is likely to play a major role in reviewing the deal and determining its fate, and it is possible that the deal could face significant opposition from lawmakers. Meanwhile, the international community will be watching closely to see how the deal is implemented and what its impact will be on the region. The deal has the potential to be a major breakthrough in US-Iran relations, but it also poses significant challenges and risks, and its success will depend on the ability of the parties to work together to implement its terms.

The report highlights the need for organizers to take necessary precautions to ensure the safety of players, officials, and spectators. With the tournament scheduled to start in less than two years, concerns about heat-related illnesses are growing.

The issue of extreme heat during sporting events is not new, but it has gained significant attention in recent years due to the increasing frequency and severity of heatwaves globally. The 2026 World Cup will be the first time the tournament is held in the United States since 1994, and the country's diverse climate will pose unique challenges for organizers. The report notes that the heat index, which takes into account temperature and humidity, will be a major concern in several cities, particularly in the southern United States. This could lead to heat-related illnesses, such as dehydration and heat exhaustion, which can be serious if not treated promptly.

According to the report, one in four World Cup matches could be played in temperatures that exceed the threshold for safe play, as defined by international sports organizations. The report cites data from previous tournaments, where players have suffered from heat-related illnesses, and warns that the 2026 World Cup could see a significant increase in such cases. Officials from FIFA, the governing body of international soccer, have stated that they are aware of the issue and are working with local organizers to develop strategies to mitigate the risks. These strategies may include scheduling matches for earlier in the day, providing additional hydration breaks, and increasing the number of medical personnel on site.

The potential for extreme heat during the 2026 World Cup has raised concerns among players, coaches, and fans, who are calling for organizers to take proactive steps to ensure a safe and successful tournament. The report's findings have also sparked a debate about the scheduling of the tournament, with some arguing that it should be held at a different time of year to avoid the peak summer heat. Others have suggested that the tournament should be held in cities with more moderate climates, although this would require significant changes to the existing schedule and infrastructure. As the tournament approaches, stakeholders will be watching closely to see how organizers respond to these concerns.

The issue of extreme heat during the 2026 World Cup has broader implications for the sports industry as a whole, highlighting the need for organizers to prioritize player safety and well-being in the face of changing environmental conditions. As global temperatures continue to rise, the risk of heat-related illnesses during sporting events will only increase, making it essential for organizers to develop strategies to mitigate these risks. The 2026 World Cup will serve as a test case for the sports industry, demonstrating how effectively organizers can respond to the challenges posed by extreme heat and ensuring a safe and successful tournament for all participants.

As the 2026 World Cup approaches, organizers will face several key decisions about how to address the issue of extreme heat, including the development of heat mitigation strategies, the scheduling of matches, and the provision of medical support. FIFA and local organizers will need to work closely together to ensure that the tournament is a success, while also prioritizing the safety and well-being of players, officials, and spectators. With the tournament just over a year away, the clock is ticking, and stakeholders will be watching closely to see how organizers respond to the challenges posed by extreme heat, and whether they can deliver a safe and successful 2026 World Cup.

A 35-year-old marathon runner suffered a heart attack during a training session, despite having normal blood pressure, blood sugar, and cholesterol levels, according to medical records. The incident has raised concerns among athletes and medical professionals about the risks of cardiovascular disease in seemingly healthy individuals. The runner, who has not been named, was taken to a hospital where he received emergency treatment and is currently recovering. This unexpected event has sparked a wider discussion about the importance of regular health check-ups and screenings for athletes.

The runner's medical history and lifestyle suggest that he was at low risk for cardiovascular disease, making the heart attack a surprising and alarming event. As an avid marathon runner, he had been training regularly and had completed several long-distance races without incident. His normal blood pressure, blood sugar, and cholesterol levels also indicated a low risk of heart disease. However, this incident highlights the complexity of cardiovascular health and the need for ongoing monitoring and evaluation, even among individuals who appear to be healthy.

According to experts, there are several factors that could have contributed to the heart attack, including genetic predisposition, underlying medical conditions, and lifestyle factors. The runner's family medical history and personal habits are being examined to determine if there were any underlying risks that may have contributed to the heart attack. Medical professionals are also reviewing the runner's training regimen and nutrition plan to see if there were any factors that may have increased his risk of cardiovascular disease. Additionally, the incident has prompted calls for more research into the causes of heart attacks in young, healthy individuals.

The incident has sent shockwaves through the athletic community, with many runners and athletes expressing concern about their own risk of cardiovascular disease. Some have taken to social media to share their own experiences with heart health and to encourage others to prioritize regular health check-ups and screenings. The incident has also prompted a renewed focus on the importance of cardiovascular health among athletes, with many coaches and trainers emphasizing the need for ongoing monitoring and evaluation. Furthermore, the incident has highlighted the need for athletes to be aware of the warning signs of a heart attack and to seek medical attention immediately if they experience any symptoms.

The incident has wider implications for public health and highlights the need for increased awareness and education about cardiovascular disease. According to the World Health Organization, cardiovascular disease is one of the leading causes of death worldwide, accounting for over 17 million deaths per year. The incident also underscores the importance of regular health check-ups and screenings, particularly among individuals who are at high risk of cardiovascular disease. Additionally, the incident has prompted calls for more research into the causes and prevention of cardiovascular disease, particularly among young, healthy individuals.

As the runner continues to recover, medical professionals and athletic organizations are working to raise awareness about the importance of cardiovascular health among athletes. The incident has prompted a renewed focus on the need for ongoing monitoring and evaluation, as well as the importance of prioritizing health and safety above athletic performance. In the coming weeks and months, athletes and medical professionals will be watching closely to see if there are any other cases of heart attacks among young, healthy individuals, and to determine if there are any steps that can be taken to prevent such incidents in the future.

Thousands of British Kashmiris gathered outside the Palace of Westminster on Sunday to protest against human rights violations in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir. The demonstrators, who came from various parts of the UK, raised concerns over reported killings and use of force against peaceful protesters in the region. The protest was peaceful, with participants carrying placards and banners demanding justice for civilians affected by the unrest. The protesters also urged the international community to take notice of the developments in the region.

The protest is the latest in a series of demonstrations held by British Kashmiris to highlight the human rights situation in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir. The region has been a point of contention between India and Pakistan for decades, with both countries claiming sovereignty over the territory. The recent crackdown on protesters in the region has sparked widespread condemnation, with many accusing the Pakistani authorities of using excessive force against civilians. The protesters in London are demanding that the international community take action to protect the human rights of the people living in the region.

According to eyewitnesses, the protest in London was attended by thousands of people, including women and children. The protesters chanted slogans calling for accountability and appealed to global human rights organizations and the United Nations to take notice of the situation in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir. The organizers of the protest claimed that the Pakistani authorities have been responsible for numerous human rights abuses in the region, including killings, disappearances, and torture. The protesters also demanded that the UK government take a stronger stance on the issue and call on the Pakistani authorities to respect the human rights of the people living in the region.

The protest has sparked a mixed reaction from stakeholders, with some welcoming the attention being drawn to the human rights situation in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir. However, others have accused the protesters of being biased and of ignoring the human rights abuses committed by the Indian authorities in the region. The Pakistani government has also responded to the protest, with a spokesperson accusing the protesters of being backed by Indian intelligence agencies. The Indian government, on the other hand, has welcomed the protest and accused the Pakistani authorities of using excessive force against civilians.

The protest in London is part of a wider campaign to highlight the human rights situation in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir. Similar protests have been held in other parts of the world, including the United States and Europe. The campaign has gained momentum in recent months, with many human rights organizations and politicians calling for action to be taken to protect the human rights of the people living in the region. The situation in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir has significant regional and global implications, with the potential to destabilize the entire region.

The outcome of the protest and the wider campaign to highlight the human rights situation in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir remains to be seen. The protesters are calling for the UK government and the international community to take action to protect the human rights of the people living in the region. items.teaser: On June 3, Omar had called a meeting of his party’s MLAs and MPs at Dachigam national park on Srinagar’s outskirts for a day-long strateg…
items.story:
On June 3, Omar had called a meeting of his party’s MLAs and MPs at Dachigam national park on Srinagar’s outskirts for a day-long strategy session that ended with a decision to protest in New Delhi on the opening day of Parliament’s monsoon session demanding restoration of J&K’s statehood. J&K lost its statehood on Aug 5, 2019, when the Centre abrogated Article 370, revoked the region's special constitutional status and bifurcated the former state into two Union territories, J&K and Ladakh.

Says National Conference government will continue pursuing Statehood “through all democratic and constitutional means”.

Reporting by Times of India. Read the full story at the original publication.

items.story:
Under the revised rates, the special additional excise duty (SAED) on diesel exports has been raised to Rs 14 per litre from Rs 13.5 per litre. The duty on ATF exports has been increased to Rs 12.5 per litre from Rs 9.5 per litre. The export duty on petrol remains unchanged at Rs 1.5 per litre. The revised rates apply for the fortnight commencing June 16

items.story: ലോകത്തിന് ആശ്വാസം പകരുന്ന അമേരിക്ക-ഇറാൻ ധാരണയ്ക്ക് മുന്നിൽ വെല്ലുവിളികളേറെയാണ്. ഇസ്രയേലിന്റെ എതിർപ്പും, ലബനൻ, സിറിയ, ഗാസ എന്നിവിടങ്ങളിലെ ഇസ്രയേലിന്റെ പിന്മാറ്റമില്ലായ്മയും, ഹോർമൂസ് കടലിടുക്കിൽ പണം ഈടാക്കാനുള്ള ഇറാന്റെ തീരുമാനവും പുതിയ സംഘർഷങ്ങൾക്ക് വഴിവെച്ചേക്കാം. ഇറാന്റെ ആണവപദ്ധതിയും മേഖലയിലെ സ്വാധീനവും നിലവിലെ ധാരണയെ കൂടുതൽ സങ്കീർണ്ണമാക്കുന്നു.

items.story: According to UNESCO, around 250 million children (16%) globally are out of school, although they are of an age to be at school in their countries. Available evidence suggests that out-of-school numbers are extremely high in conflict-affected countries, though the exact number is hard to quantify. For example, in the Central African Republic, South Sudan and Eritrea, more than 50% of primary school-age children are not going to school.

items.story: A cottage industry has emerged on Chinese e-commerce platforms selling tiny plastic doll heads designed to trick Tesla’s cabin camera into thinking a driver is paying attention. The devices cost as little as $20 to $50. The products — marketed as “travel companions” and “dashboard decorations” — represent the latest and most absurd escalation in the arms race between Tesla’s driver monitoring safeguards and people determined to defeat them. It’s also incredibly dangerous and irresponsible.
